questions.q: Which principle of training means fitness is lost when training stops?
questions.why: Reversibility is ‘use it or lose it’: gains disappear if training stops or reduces.

questions.q: What is the maximum heart rate of a 16-year-old using the standard formula?
Which method uses exercises such as box jumps and depth jumps to improve power?
questions.why: Plyometrics uses explosive bounding and jumping to develop power.

questions.q: Explain why a footballer might use fartlek training in the pre-season.
questions.model: Fartlek mixes walking, jogging and sprinting at changing speeds. This matches the varied pace of football and builds both aerobic and anaerobic fitness for the season.
points: changes of pace / speed play matches football
